name: omni-nexus
description: Omni Nexus LLM tagging + NovelAI overlay

scripts.test:settings-ux: node tools/extract-preview-ux.mjs && node tools/check-settings-ux.mjs && node tools/check-settings-search.mjs && node tools/check-note-extras.mjs && node tools/check-character-switch.mjs && node tools/check-spinner-layout.mjs && node tools/check-character-integration.mjs && node tools/check-character-name-draft.mjs && node tools/check-character-loading.mjs && node tools/check-image-output.mjs && node tools/check-character-dock.mjs && node tools/check-character-select.mjs && node tools/check-preset-select.mjs && node tools/check-author-note-presets.mjs && node tools/check-host-traffic.mjs
scripts.unit: node tools/build-tests.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=4 --test-timeout=120000 --test-skip-pattern=SafeDOM tests/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/tts-host.test.mjs
scripts.bench: node tools/bench-gallery.mjs --route=gallery && node tools/bench-gallery.mjs --route=explore && node tools/bench-gallery.mjs --route=window && node tools/bench-gallery.mjs --route=arrows
scripts.parity: npm run parity:old && npm run parity:new && node tools/parity/compare.mjs .parity/old.json .parity/new.json
scripts.test:tts: node --test --test-concurrency=4 --test-timeout=60000 --test-skip-pattern=SafeDOM tests/tts-*.test.mjs tests/sound-*.test.mjs tests/float-viewer.test.mjs && node --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/tts-host.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run unit && npm run build && npm run audit && npm run smoke && npm run bench && npm run parity && npm run test:settings-ux
